2.88.49
Chart.Style
The Chart.Style element specifies the style information for a Chart. This element is optional. The
Chart.Style element is of type Style.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.Style element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
